head: 07052b67de5be986998fc4bc21a6aa3cb6c3caaf
rationale: The change documents that the sessions directory carries a .gitignore, but no code writes it; the test passes vacuously because git status collapses the untracked directory to .ocra/.

expect.concern: Nothing in the change writes the .gitignore the docs promise, and the test cannot notice: it filters .gitignore out without requiring it, and git status --porcelain reports the new untracked directory as .ocra/, so not.toContain('.ocra/sessions') passes anyway.
